glasses_omar: Highly volatile. Missed bathroom_shelf_ba1 (07:10) and bed_b1 (21:47) by assuming coffee_table_l1. The "coffee_table_l1 first" rule is invalid for this item. Check bathroom_shelf_ba1, bed_b1, and nightstand_b1 before living room spots.

mug_omar: Unstable between kitchen and living room. Missed kitchen_table_k1 (08:10) and coffee_table_l1 (11:41). Do not lock in one location. Check kitchen_table_k1 and coffee_table_l1 with equal priority.

book_omar: No longer consistently at coffee_table_l1. Missed couch_l1 (16:45) and bed_b1 (20:32) by assuming coffee_table_l1. The item moves to seating and sleeping areas. Check couch_l1, bed_b1, and coffee_table_l1.

charger_omar: Missed nightstand_b1 (22:21) by assuming coffee_table_l1. The bedroom nightstand is a valid location. Check nightstand_b1 and coffee_table_l1.

water_bottle_omar: No misses today. Previous note to check coffee_table_l1 immediately remains relevant as no counter-evidence was provided.

glass_omar: No misses today. Previous note to check cupboard_k1 and kitchen_table_k1 remains relevant.

General: The previous general rule that "coffee_table_l1 is the dominant location for Omar’s personal items" is incorrect. It led to 5 of 7 errors today. Abandon this heuristic. Omar’s items are distributed across living, bedroom, bathroom, and kitchen spots. Do not default to coffee_table_l1 for any item.
